title: Small Totem Model
description: Make The Totem Model small / mini With Custom png Support
body:
#What is this?

this resourcepack make the totem of undying model smaller without changing the texture which mean you can use any other resourcepack that change the totem of undying texture and it will make it small! 

That how it look with normal totem 
- ![normal totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VGxhdg7c/images/96466daae58b77b1c84116e20519e65f57c4f35c_350.webp)

and if you use a Custom Texture for the totem it will look like this
- ![Custom Totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/VGxhdg7c/images/76c82c94bee7017352f02303a09088387d55a37c_350.webp)
